description: Propose a part of an AI agent for the lab to switch on and off. Kinds: line (an instruction), block (a persona or rules block placed before the instructions), example, skill (name + text), tool (calculator, or run: the agent runs its own code in a sandbox), stack (two to four lines switched on together), setting (thinking on/off, effort low/medium/high), route (claude-sonnet-5-5 or claude-opus-5-5). Returns the proposal id; the verdict arrives when its cycle publishes.

base_thinking.description: The base agent the part is tested against

lines.description: For stack: two to four lines switched on together, in order

suite.description: Which suite of tasks; opsin_suites lists them

text.description: For line, block, example and skill

tool.description: For tool: calculator (exact arithmetic, the default) or run (its own code)

name: opsin_propose
